sitat: approximately 81% of the increase in UI benefit receipt for manipulators is mechanically due to longer coverage, while the remaining 19% is the result of a decline in job search effort caused by longer PBD.
We show that for one euro of mechanical UI transfer towards manipulators the government pays an additional 24 cents due to behavioural responses during non-employment.
